gradeRuling.form: D-005 form. Is preview-product-boundary-successor.v11, as bytes, acceptable at application grade — T2-02's "application-grade acceptance with no express reservation" — as DR-117's preview-scoped design candidate? Answered against these bytes, not preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's.
reasons: The subject exists to perform one act — the D-294 Decision 3 refresh — and the partition half of that act is incomplete on the two lineages whose partitions moved. Six present-tense sentences inside enforcementEvidence.classes state that OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING is leftoverDesign true on g29-leftover-join.v7 and that OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING is leftoverDesign true on g30-leftover-join.v10. Both joins measure summary.leftoverDesign as the empty list. Application grade cannot rest on bytes that misstate the measurement the bytes were written to correct.

The false sentences are operative, not decorative. EE-5a, EE-7a and EE-7b are the CELL-2 routing for item 5, the useful-install inventory and the TypeScript-only role. A later SATISFIED-GRADE cycle resting on this subject would read G29 and G30 fixture authoring as live leftover-design at gates whose current joins place those obligations in specifiedNotLeftover.

The subject contradicts itself on the same measurement at the same routing depth. leftoverDesignOpenStanding, basedOn.g29JoinV7.role, basedOn.g30JoinV10.role, joinCurrencyAudit.joins and classesRefresh.trigger all state the empty list; EE-1, EE-2, EE-3b, EE-4, EE-5b, EE-6a and EE-7d state it too. A reader cannot determine from these bytes which of the two readings the candidate advances, and an internally contradictory measurement is not application-grade acceptable.

doesNot[17] carries preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's twenty-two-obligation enumeration forward while defining it as a present-tense measurement of the twelve current joins, so the wrong bucket also survives in the boundary statement a later cycle reads as the successor's own.

basedOn.predecessorPinningShape, rewritten at this successor, asserts a pinning shape three of its own six predecessor objects do not have, regressing the hedge preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 used to make the same sentence true, and lineage.contractRelationship still tells a reader the D-056 Class A opening's naming is undecided in a record where D-316 decided it. Neither is the ruling's ground; both are byte-level defects a candidate carrying the application-grade limb should not carry.

What is sound is sound, and a successor that repairs the six sentences, doesNot[17], predecessorPinningShape and lineage.contractRelationship without disturbing anything else would be answering a narrow list. The currency measurement over both heading spellings, the four-moved / eight-unmoved partition, the supersession labelling, the 107 recordedInputs digests, the D-316 recitation and the class / disposition / p1p2g3Mapping equality against preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 all hold as bytes.
gradeRuling.sweepMethod: This verdict was searched for reservation language — sustained-subject-to, sustained-except, provided-that, conditional-on, reserved-pending, without-prejudice, sustained-in-part — and for any sentence granting application grade under a carve-out. The ruling is NOT SUSTAINED outright and grants no partial or conditional application grade, so no sentence of this verdict carries a reservation. An empty list means none.
gradeRuling.whatSustainedWouldHaveMeant: SUSTAINED FOR APPLICATION would have marked nothing SATISFIED. It is withheld here because the bytes misstate a live cross-lineage measurement, not because DR-117's grade question is answered against the candidate in principle.
